title: Opt this repo's lore skill into the opum-lore plugin (skill_source=plugin, mirrors QCLI-236)
description: Directed by opum-agent (2026-09-05): lore 0.4.3 (published, LCLI-443/444) ships the same skill_source opt-out for lore's own per-repo Claude Code skill that QCLI-236 just built for quest's. quest-cli itself carries .claude/skills/lore/SKILL.md and should dogfood lore's opt-out the same way it dogfooded its own under QCLI-236. Distinct from QCLI-236: this is LORE's skill, not quest's - lore owns this feature entirely, quest-cli is just an adopting repository. Steps per the orchestrator's exact instruction: npm i -g @opum-ai/lore@0.4.3 (confirmed already installed at 0.4.3); lore init --skill-source plugin; lore agents --check must report .claude/skills/lore/SKILL.md orphaned, exit 6; lore agents --force regenerates CLAUDE.md's lore nudge and removes the file only if byte-identical - if it refuses (hand-edited), git rm -r .claude/skills/lore by hand per its remedy; lore agents --check exit 0; fleet digest must stay 9eddf7883da91a63 (unchanged, this only touches the lore:agents block, not opum:fleet-operating); lore check 0; any prose naming the deleted path repointed at opum-lore:lore.

acceptanceCriteria.text: quest-cli-committed .lore/config.toml declares [agents] skill_source = "plugin" (or lore's equivalent on-disk form)
.claude/skills/lore/SKILL.md is deleted from this repository - either via lore agents --force (byte-exact match) or a manual git rm per lore's own remedy if it refused
CLAUDE.md's lore:agents nudge block is regenerated to point at the opum-lore plugin rather than the deleted per-repo path
The opum:fleet-operating block digest is confirmed unchanged (9eddf7883da91a63) since this change is scoped to the lore:agents block only
Any other prose in this repository naming the deleted .claude/skills/lore/SKILL.md path is repointed at opum-lore:lore

implementationNotes: Ran the exact sequence given: lore --version confirmed 0.4.3 already installed (shared machine). lore init --skill-source plugin persisted [agents]\nskill_source = "plugin" into .lore/config.toml (also synced a new schema file, attested-computation.schema.json, unrelated normal lore init behavior). lore agents --check reported 'orphaned .claude/skills/lore/SKILL.md' + 'bridge carries a file config says should not exist', exit 6, exactly as expected. lore agents --force regenerated CLAUDE.md's lore:agents nudge ('updated CLAUDE.md') but refused to remove the skill file itself (reported still orphaned, 'delete by hand'), exit 0 - confirms the pre-existing QCLI-233 finding that this file was already out-of-date-protected/non-byte-exact before this task touched anything, so --force correctly refused per its own safety property rather than force-deleting non-matching content. Used the documented fallback exactly as instructed: git rm -r .claude/skills/lore. Re-ran lore agents --check: exit 0. Fleet digest verified unchanged by computing it locally with the workflow's own formula (awk opum:fleet-operating:begin/end | shasum -a 256 | cut -c1-16) rather than assuming: 9eddf7883da91a63, matches. git diff -U0 CLAUDE.md confirms only line 52 (inside the lore:agents block) changed; the fleet block (lines 140-311) untouched. lore check: 63 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings, exit 0. Grepped the whole repo (excluding node_modules/.quest/.pi/) for any remaining .claude/skills/lore reference: none found, nothing to repoint.
finalSummary: Dogfooded lore 0.4.3's skill_source=plugin opt-out on quest-cli's own lore skill, mirroring how QCLI-236 dogfooded quest's own. .lore/config.toml now declares [agents] skill_source = "plugin"; CLAUDE.md's lore:agents nudge was regenerated by lore agents --force to point at the opum-lore plugin instead of the deleted path; the skill file itself (.claude/skills/lore/SKILL.md) had already drifted from current-generated content before this task (a pre-existing QCLI-233 finding), so --force correctly refused to delete it and it was removed by hand per lore's own documented remedy. lore agents --check now exits 0. Fleet digest independently reverified unchanged (9eddf7883da91a63) by computing it locally with the CI workflow's own formula, not assumed. lore check clean.
